description: Live search of Booking.com, Vrbo and Expedia Group (hotel rooms) for the dates and party, verified against the map. Returns up to three picks (best overall, best value, closest) with receipts and tracked openUrl links. Takes 30 to 90 seconds; returns status 'running' with a searchId if it is not done within waitSeconds. Three searches on the house per connection, then a key (free account: 10 a month; Pro: unlimited).

budget.description: Super-cheap brands (Motel 6, Econo Lodge and the like) are out on every budget. value = cheapest that passes, mid = balanced, splurge = the nicest (ranked on star class and reviews, not price; no hotel under four stars or from an economy or limited-service brand; mid has none under three)

checkOut.description: YYYY-MM-DD, 1 to 90 nights after checkIn (Booking.com is skipped past 30 nights; Vrbo quotes longer stays)

flexDays.description: Date flexibility for the alert watcher: 0, 1, 2, 3 or 7 days

hotelBrands.description: Hotel loyalty: keep hotel picks inside these groups (marriott, hilton, hyatt, ihg, accor, wyndham, choice, bestwestern); whole homes are unaffected

intent.description: What the trip is for, in the traveler's words: 'kayaking', 'a cooking class', 'a quiet writing week'. Steers things to do, never the ranking.

maxPerNightUsd.description: Hard cap per night in US dollars, all-in (taxes and fees included); kept per night, so the stay total follows the dates. Use instead of maxTotalUsd when the traveler gives a nightly figure (the top of a range).

maxTotalUsd.description: Hard cap on the whole-stay total in US dollars, taxes and fees included

nearLandmark.description: A place the traveler wants to be near: 'Zilker Park', 'the old town', 'Shinkansen station'

pets.description: A pet is coming: only listings whose own policy allows pets

stayType.description: entire = whole apartments and houses (default); hotel = hotel rooms (Booking.com and Expedia Group); any = rentals and hotel rooms side by side, each tagged; resort = resorts and all-inclusives, Booking.com only, priced per person too

travellerCountry.description: ISO-2 country the traveler lives in (default US); decides whether an eSIM line applies

waitSeconds.description: How long to wait for the search before returning a running status

walkTo.description: What should be within a ten-minute walk

where.description: City or town, with state or country when ambiguous: 'Lisbon', 'Wimberley, TX', 'Kyoto, Japan'.

name: search_stays
title: Search stays with receipts
